preconditions.description: The number of possible splits m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of different monster types n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= mi <= n for mi in monster_ids)
preconditions.description: Each monster ID in the split rules must be between 1 and n.
Each split rule must have at least one monster or diamond.
The total number of elements in all split rules must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(smallest, int) and isinstance(largest, int) for smallest, largest in results)
postconditions.description: For each monster, the output must contain two integers representing the smallest and largest number of diamonds.

postconditions.expression: all(-1 <= smallest <= 314000000 and -1 <= largest <= 314000000 for smallest, largest in results)
postconditions.description: The smallest and largest number of diamonds must be within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: any(largest == -2 for smallest, largest in results)
postconditions.description: If any monster can produce an arbitrarily large number of diamonds, the largest value must be -2.
